reader_architecture.ue1: Own CatalogUE1PackageReader, CatalogUE1BinaryStream and Uedb5UE1TableSnapshotBuilder; no UE2 file dependency.
reader_architecture.ue2: Own CatalogUE2PackageReader, CatalogUE2BinaryStream and Uedb5UE2TableSnapshotBuilder; own UE2 legacy compatibility reader/snapshot, no UE1 module dependency.
reader_architecture.ue5: UE5/UnrealPackageReader.php UnrealPackageReader5 plus separate Zen/IoStore reader and package store
reader_architecture.change_impact: Concrete package readers, byte streams and table snapshot serializers are separated by engine; shared catalog application, job scheduler and provider/dependency services still impact all applicable engines.
